Class TerrainGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.terrain.TerrainGenerator
public final class TerrainGenerator extends Object
Generates deterministic terrain heights, surface weights, and vegetation-placement fields from a single world seed. Instances are immutable after construction and can be shared by background chunk-generation tasks.
